description: Absorb the excluded-character term into one additional x^eps factor under explicit large-x and comparison hypotheses.

      x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 6) * eps))

      K * x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + eps)) :
    G ≤ x ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + (eD + eL + 7) * eps) := by
__PROOF__

end RHGym
